h1: Calmly Stay Ratchada — A Balcony Room and Real Value Just Seven Minutes' Walk from Praram 9 Hospital
intro: If you need a base in Bangkok for treatment at Praram 9 Hospital, or for any business in the Rama 9 CBD corridor, Calmly Stay Ratchada is one of the most practical choices you will find. This eight-room boutique sits on Soi Thaweemit 5 in Huai Khwang — a residential soi just off Rama IX Road — and sits only 480 m from Praram 9 Hospital, a 7-minute walk with no need for a taxi. Every room (or nearly so) has a private balcony, walls finished in warm timber tones, fast Wi-Fi, and a solid air-conditioning unit. Rooms start from approximately ฿800 per night, which is exceptional value for this location. The score is 9.2 out of 10 from 44 verified reviews on Trip.com.

body.html: Calmly Stay Ratchada is a small owner-managed boutique hotel on Soi Thaweemit 5, tucked just off the Rama IX Road corridor in Huai Khwang. The hotel opened in recent years and has built a strong reputation quickly, scoring 9.2 out of 10 on Trip.com — a remarkable figure for a property this size. The central draw for most guests is the distance to Praram 9 Hospital: 480 metres, or about seven minutes on foot. When a family member is going to hospital daily, that difference between walking and waiting for a ride adds up — and at ฿800–฿1,100 per night, the total cost of the stay is meaningfully lower than most nearby alternatives.

The eight rooms divide into four types. The entry-level Standard Double Room has a queen bed with no balcony. Step up to the Standard Balcony or Superior Balcony and you gain a private outdoor space — the feature guest after guest highlights in reviews. At the top sits the Superior Triple Balcony, which sleeps three with a king bed plus single, making it viable for families accompanying a patient. Every room is fitted with a refrigerator, electric kettle, television, free Wi-Fi, slippers and toiletries. The decor is warm and straightforward — timber panelling, clean lines, nothing pretentious. Cleanliness scores 9.4 out of 10 from guests, which for a budget-tier hotel is genuinely impressive.

"Superb value — the owner and her son are incredibly attentive, room quality is excellent for the price, and the location is perfect for the hospital. We walked there every morning. Would absolutely stay again."

Reviews across multiple platforms converge on the same themes. The owner's personal attention is mentioned in almost every review: she runs the property herself, responds to requests quickly, helps guests arrange taxis, and goes out of her way to make things comfortable. Service scores 9.3 out of 10. The Wi-Fi earns repeated praise as fast and reliable — important when you are spending long hours waiting in a hospital and need to be reachable. The location score of 9.1 reflects how useful the immediate area is: 7-Eleven stores, coffee shops and local restaurants are within walking distance, and Central Rama 9 shopping centre is a short Grab ride away.

Getting further afield is straightforward without being entirely effortless. MRT Phra Ram 9 (Blue Line) is 970 metres from the hotel — roughly a 12-minute walk or a 5-minute Grab. From Phra Ram 9 station you can reach Asok (BTS interchange) in a few stops, or continue to Hua Lamphong or Chatuchak. The Ratchada night-market scene and Train Night Market are nearby. The honest note on transport: this is not a hotel where you step outside and hail a taxi instantly or walk to BTS. The neighbourhood is calm and residential, which is exactly what most hospital-visit guests want — but sightseers who need constant transit access might find it slightly inconvenient.

The weaknesses that appear in the reviews are worth knowing. There is no parking at the property — guests arriving by private car need to find street parking nearby. The building has no lift, which matters if you have heavy luggage or mobility limitations. One or two guests mentioned a drain smell in the bathroom on occasion, and a handful noted that pre-arrival contact (via Line or phone) sometimes went unanswered for a while. The hotel has only eight rooms, meaning availability can tighten fast during busy periods — advance booking is strongly recommended. None of these issues are showstoppers for the target guest, but they are worth knowing before you arrive with two suitcases and a relative in a wheelchair.

With an overall score of 9.2 from 44 reviews — Cleanliness 9.4, Service 9.3, Location 9.1, Facilities 8.9 — Calmly Stay Ratchada is performing at a level well above its price tier. The consistent praise across international guests (English, Thai, Nigerian and more nationality combinations appear in the review pool) suggests the quality is not luck but deliberate effort by the management. For patients and families at Praram 9 Hospital, it is about as close as you can get while still having a proper hotel room with a balcony — and at a price that won't compound the stress of a medical trip.

highlights.title: 7-min walk to Praram 9 Hospital
highlights.text: Only 480 m from Praram 9 Hospital — step out the front door and walk. No taxi wait, no app required. The most practical option for daily hospital visits in this part of Bangkok.

highlights.title: Private balcony in every room
highlights.text: Almost every room type includes a private balcony overlooking the city. A welcome place to decompress after a long hospital day — the single most praised feature across all reviews.

highlights.title: Genuinely affordable for the location
highlights.text: From approximately ฿800/night during regular season — significantly cheaper than branded hotels in the same area, with cleanliness and service scores that rival them.

honestSummary: Calmly Stay Ratchada is a strong match for patients and families at Praram 9 Hospital, and for budget-conscious travellers in the Ratchada area — spotless, balcony rooms, genuinely low prices, walking distance to the hospital. The trade-offs are no parking, no lift, and a small room count that requires advance booking.
honestChecks: If you are arriving by car — there is no on-site parking. You will need to find a space on nearby streets or in a commercial car park. Check with the property before booking if this is a concern.
If you have mobility limitations or heavy luggage — the building has stairs but no lift. Guests recovering from procedures should factor this in before choosing this property.
If you need full hotel facilities — Calmly Stay is a compact boutique with no pool, gym or on-site restaurant. If those matter to you, consider other options in the roundup.

tips.title: Walk to Praram 9 Hospital
tips.body: Head out onto Soi Thaweemit 5 and follow it to Rama IX Road — the hospital entrance is about 480 m and 7 minutes away on foot. Far easier than calling a ride, especially for multiple daily trips.

tips.title: MRT Phra Ram 9 — your transit hub
tips.body: MRT Phra Ram 9 (Blue Line) is about 970 m away — a 12-minute walk or quick Grab. From there you can reach Asok BTS interchange, Hua Lamphong, Chatuchak and most of Bangkok without fuss.

tips.title: Give taxi drivers the Thai address
tips.body: The hotel name is English-only, which can confuse local taxi drivers. It sits on Soi Thaweemit 5, off Rama IX Road in Huai Khwang — save the Thai-script address from your booking confirmation to show the driver.

tips.title: Book ahead — only 8 rooms
tips.body: With just eight rooms, the hotel fills up quickly on weekends and during peak hospital-admission periods. Book via an OTA rather than trying to call; it is faster and you can see real-time availability.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Calmly Stay Ratchada

faq.q: Where is Calmly Stay Ratchada, and how far is it from Praram 9 Hospital?
faq.a: Calmly Stay Ratchada is at 61/157 Soi Thaweemit 5, Rama IX Road, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310. It is 480 metres from Praram 9 Hospital — approximately a 7-minute walk with no taxi required. MRT Phra Ram 9 (Blue Line) is about 970 m away, roughly a 12-minute walk or 5-minute Grab.

faq.q: How much does Calmly Stay Ratchada cost per night?
faq.a: Prices start from approximately ฿800/night for a Standard Double Room. Rooms with a private balcony start at around ฿900, and the Superior Triple Balcony (sleeps 3) is around ฿1,100. Prices vary by season and platform — compare Agoda, Booking.com and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Does Calmly Stay Ratchada have parking?
faq.a: There is no on-site car parking. Guests driving themselves need to find street parking or a nearby commercial car park. If you are travelling without a car — by MRT or Grab — the location is very convenient.

faq.q: Does the hotel have a lift?
faq.a: Currently no lift — the building uses stairs to upper floors. Guests with heavy luggage, elderly guests, or patients recovering from procedures should factor this in before booking.

faq.q: Is Calmly Stay Ratchada suitable for a hospital stay at Praram 9 Hospital?
faq.a: Yes, it is one of the most practical options available. At 480 m (7 min walk) from Praram 9 Hospital, you can walk there and back without arranging transport. The rooms are clean and comfortable, the owner is attentive, and prices are low enough to ease the financial pressure of a medical trip.
